result.instructions: Tools for Motivosity, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who has been recognised the most this month on the leaderboard?"; "Show the recognition feed for last week with who liked each item."; "Who are the direct reports of our head of sales?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Motivosity data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run motivosity_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run motivosity_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run motivosity_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. motivosity_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: motivosity_list_company_values
tools.title: List company values
tools.description: List the company values that recognitions can be tagged with. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/companyvalue.

tools.name: motivosity_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users with department, title, supervisor and status. Filter by name or department and sort by any field. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/user.

scope.description: Who to include: TEAM (your team), EXTM (extended team), DEPT (department) or CMPY (company).

name.description: Match on first, last or preferred name.

sort.description: Sort field, for example +firstName or -createdDate (+ ascending, - descending).

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, for example firstName,lastName,email.

tools.name: motivosity_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Find users whose name or email contains the text. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/user/search.

name.description: Part of a name, a full name or an email address.

ignoreSelf.description: Leave out the caller's own account.

tools.name: motivosity_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one user's details. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/user/{userId}.

tools.name: motivosity_get_user_profile
tools.title: Get user profile
tools.description: Get one user's profile (about text, interests, personality type, location). Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/user/{userId}/profile.

tools.name: motivosity_get_direct_reports
tools.title: Get direct reports
tools.description: Get the direct reports of one user from the org chart. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/orgchart/dr.

tools.name: motivosity_get_org_chart_partial
tools.title: Get org chart section
tools.description: Get a part of the org chart around one user, down a number of levels. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/orgchart/partial.

levels.description: How many levels below the user to include.

rollupNumber.description: Include the total head count under each person.

tools.name: motivosity_get_recent_feed
tools.title: Get recent feed
tools.description: Get the most recent recognition and activity feed items, optionally with likes and comments. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/feed.

comment.description: Include the comments on each item.

scope.description: Always the whole company: a service account always reads company scope.

feedTypes.description: Feed types to include. Omit for the home-feed types.

tools.name: motivosity_get_all_feed
tools.title: Get feed by date range
tools.description: Get feed items within a date range, including upcoming birthdays and anniversaries. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/feed/all.

comment.description: Include the comments on each item.

scope.description: Always the whole company: a service account always reads company scope.

feedTypes.description: Feed types to include. Omit to include all types.

tools.name: motivosity_get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get leaderboard
tools.description: Get the recognition leaderboard for this month, this year or the top 10. Motivosity API: GET /api/v2/leaderboard.

type.description: Board to return: month, year or top10.

tools.name: motivosity_give_platform_appreciation
tools.title: Give platform appreciation
tools.description: Post a recognition from this integration (not from a user) to one or more people, optionally tagged with a company value. This is visible to the company. Motivosity API: PUT /api/v2/platformappreciation.

note.description: The message to send with the recognition.

amount.description: Optional amount. The vendor applies its own budget rules.

companyValueID.description: Company value id (use this or companyValue).

companyValue.description: Company value name (use this or companyValueID).

tools.name: motivosity_give_award
tools.title: Give award
tools.description: Give an award to one or more people. A service account can give only central-budget awards, and the award is created by this app. Motivosity API: PUT /api/v2/award/{awardId}/giveaward.

awardId.description: Award id from the awards list in Motivosity.

note.description: Note to send with the award.
